en.plain:
The life cost written in this card's [Cast Cost] is reduced by 1 for each "Divine Dragon Creation" in your drop zone.
[Cast Cost] [Pay 2 life]
[Cn/Turn] Draw a card. Then, put a "Divine Dragon Creation" from your drop zone into your hand, or draw a card and put this card into your gauge.
